parole.testo: From Middle Dutch alrune, possibly derived from Old High German alrūna, otherwise derived from a common source. The second element -ruin is held to be derived from Proto-Germanic *rūnō (“secret, mystery”), seemingly due to the plant's association with witchcraft.

From Middle Dutch hêre, from Old Dutch hērro, hēro, from Old High German hēriro, hērro, the comparative form of hēr (“noble, venerable”) (German hehr), by analogy with Latin senior (“elder”).
